newsitem.title: USA: Pogo says to offer $100 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Pogo says to offer $100 mln in notes.

text.p: Pogo Producing Co said Wednesday it plans to offer $100 million of senior subordinated notes due 2007.
The company said the offering will be made by means of an offering memorandum to qualified institutional buyers, and the securities will have several registration rights.
Proceeds of the offering will be used to repay outstanding senior debt, including amounts outstanding under its revolving credit facility.

The company said the notes offered have not been and will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
